task_definition.task_description: Please scan the living room for smart devices, then check which sensor devices are connected there. After that, diagnose all issues for the living room devices, check the status of the living room light, set that light to 75% brightness, and then create a snapshot report from `/workspace/project_a` named `backup_2025_06` with the title `Trip Summary` and send me a medium-priority app alert for user `user_001`.

user_input.query: Please scan the living_room for smart devices and then check which connected devices of type sensor are there. After that, diagnose any issues with all devices in the living_room, check the status of the light with device ID light_living, and set light_living to 75% brightness. Then create a snapshot report from /workspace/project_a named backup_2025_06 with the title Trip Summary, and send me a medium-priority app alert for user_001.
user_input.title: Trip Summary
